notes.title: Controller quality of life update !
notes.content:
Hey everyone ! 

We made a few final updates : 
- Changed the vertical axis on the controller so it feels better
- Fixed a UI display bug occurring when reaching the first special interactible (the intercom).

Thank you for your support and we hope you enjoy our game !

notes.title: Summer update - We heard your feedback !
notes.content:
Hey everyone ! Thanks for playing our game and giving us honest reviews. 
We've been working on adding a few things in order to take into account as much of your feedback as possible :


- Gamepad control is now fully implemented
- There is an option to remove motion blur, should this setting make you sick
- A few overall bugfixes here and there

Now some reviews were about our narrative and game decisions, and these will not change. As it was a student projet, we do not wish to alter it further and are deeply sorry for anyone who thought there was a branching path at some point. Carl's story is unmovable, and none of his decisions (nor the player's) can change how events happen. 

Thank you for reading and we hope you enjoy our latest build !
